meaning.en: The definition of automatization means using machinery or other technology to allow processes to take place without human input or work.
meaning.vi: Định nghĩa của tự động hóa có nghĩa là sử dụng máy móc hoặc công nghệ khác để cho phép các quá trình diễn ra mà không cần sự tham gia của con người hoặc công việc.

meaning.en: A process of making an action of a higher animal reflexive.
meaning.vi: Một quá trình thực hiện một hành động của động vật bậc cao có tính phản xạ.

sentences.en: For improving production efficiency automatization level of the wooden floor, a continuous flitch machine was developed.

sentences.en: This tester has functions of whole-procedure automatization, temperature compensation, automatic pressure value corrected to standard atmospheric condition, and so on.

sentences.en: Computer room is the supreme headquarters about information automatization in a university library. Safety in the computer room is an important guarantee to daily library work.

sentences.en: The automatization appearance and control equipment as a industry automatization technology is rdaching at a genuine numeral intelligentize and network age with the driving of high and new technology.

sentences.en: Along with development of newspapering, automatization of newspaper machine is greatly improving.

sentences.en: With the improvement of agricultural automatization, more and more study focuses on automatically processing image and extracting information.

sentences.en: The research of this system would realize the automatization of weighing up vary kinds of cannon-shot and typewriting, reduce the intensity of labor and improve the work efficiency.
